feeds.title: BreadVillage Talk
feeds.description: BreadVillage is the online bread shop that brings world-class artisan bread from Germany straight to your door. We focus on German bread, because it's among the best bread types in the world: Crunchy outside, dense and chewy inside, loaded with good ingredients. Our mission is to turn your home into a bakery: We achieve this by shipping partially baked (or par-baked) bread that develops great texture in your oven within minutes.
